articles.title: Somaliland: Israel ernennt ersten Botschafter für Somaliland

articles.image_title: Somaliland: SOMALILAND-RELIGION-RAMDAN People walk by the flags of Israel and Somaliland flying alongside each other at the entrance to a fruit farm between the capital city of Hargeisa and Port city of Berbera along the highway connecting the two as Muslims commemorate the holy month of Ramdhan in Somaliland on February 19, 2026. "I love Israel." The expression, almost incongruous in the Muslim world, resonates regularly in Somaliland, less than two months after the Israeli government recognized the independence of this self-proclaimed republic, which seceded from Somalia in 1991. Young and old, men and women alike... in this land of Islam where Ramadan has just begun, almost everyone emphasizes the injustice they believe has been rectified by Israel, the first country in the world to legitimize their nation's existence. (Photo by Tony KARUMBA / AFP via Getty Images)
